entry.title: A simple backup scheme for wallet accounts
entry.summary:
The discussion raises concerns about the consistency of cryptographic signatures across different signing devices or software versions, especially when considering deterministic behaviors essential in Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 138 (BIP138). The email points out that using an extended public key (xpub) from a specific derivation path like `m/138'/` could offer similar benefits for encryption purposes that are typically sought in other methods. However, there is skepticism regarding the operational advantages of this approach, assuming proper xpub management practices are maintained.
The emphasis is on the potential pitfalls ('footgun') that might arise when applying these techniques without careful consideration of the underlying technical and security implications. This suggests a need for further analysis and possibly more robust handling strategies to ensure that the use of such cryptographic tools aligns with best practices and security standards in blockchain technologies.
